Warrior.name: Athletics
Warrior.used_for: Climbing, running, jumping, swimming, and flying.

Warrior.name: Endurance
Warrior.used_for: Pushing through pain, fatigue, poison, and harsh conditions.

Warrior.name: Martial Arts
Warrior.used_for: Fighting unarmed: fists, kicks, grapples, and throws.

Warrior.name: Melee
Warrior.used_for: Fighting with blades, axes, polearms, shields, and other hand weapons.

Rogue.name: Chicanery
Rogue.used_for: Cons, disguises, tricks, and dirty tactics.

Rogue.name: Dodge
Rogue.used_for: Getting out of the way of attacks and hazards.

Rogue.name: Sleight of Hand
Rogue.used_for: Picking pockets, palming objects, and quick-fingered work.

Troubadour.name: Expression
Troubadour.used_for: Art, writing, and putting ideas and feelings across.

Troubadour.name: Performance
Troubadour.used_for: Music, acting, dance, and entertaining a crowd.

Troubadour.name: Presence
Troubadour.used_for: Force of personality: impressing, commanding, and intimidating.

Troubadour.name: Persuasion
Troubadour.used_for: Convincing others with argument or appeal.

Troubadour.name: Subterfuge
Troubadour.used_for: Lying, misdirection, and hiding your intentions.

Noble.name: Diplomacy
Noble.used_for: Negotiating and settling disputes between parties.

Noble.name: Etiquette
Noble.used_for: Manners, protocol, and moving through high society.

Noble.name: Pilot
Noble.used_for: Sailing ships and piloting any vehicle.

Mage.name: Alchemy
Mage.used_for: Brewing potions and working with reagents.

Mage.name: Attunement
Mage.used_for: Bonding with and drawing on magical items and attuned effects.

Mage.name: Circle Magic
Mage.used_for: Ritual magic: scrolls, wards, contracts, summoning. Counts toward your Mana Pool.

Mage.name: Implements
Mage.used_for: Using and working with crafted magical devices.

Mage.name: Magic
Mage.used_for: Casting spells from the schools. Counts toward your Mana Pool.

Sage.name: Artifacts
Sage.used_for: Understanding, handling, and repairing magical artifacts.

Sage.name: Insight
Sage.used_for: Reading people, their motives, and their lies.

Sage.name: Survival
Sage.used_for: Tracking, foraging, and living off the land.

scales.name: Humility / Pride
scales.tension: Where do I place my own worth relative to others?

scales.name: Charity / Greed
scales.tension: Do I give or do I keep?

scales.name: Chastity / Lust
scales.tension: Do I restrain or do I pursue?

scales.name: Patience / Wrath
scales.tension: Do I endure or do I act on my anger?

scales.name: Temperance / Gluttony
scales.tension: Do I hold back or do I commit fully?

scales.name: Kindness / Envy
scales.tension: Do I care for others or do I want what they have?

scales.name: Diligence / Sloth
scales.tension: Do I work or do I rest?

freebie_presets.name: Veteran
freebie_presets.note: Double the points. Check with your Storyteller.

freebie_presets.name: Legend
freebie_presets.note: Double again. Check with your Storyteller.

points.text: 3 for a hand or foot, 5 for an arm or leg

options.name: Hex of Small Misfortunes
options.text: Once per session, the Storyteller can turn one of your successful rolls on a minor task outside combat into a failure. It can only cause a small inconvenience, such as a dropped key, a snapped bootstring, or ink spilled on a letter, never real harm or the loss of a scene.

options.name: Beast's Dread
options.text: Animals hate you. You take a penalty die on Ride and on any roll to calm, train, or bond with a creature, and mounts throw you when startled.

options.name: Ill-Starred
options.text: The first Fate point you spend each session does nothing.

options.name: Withering Flesh
options.text: Healing magic and potions heal 1 less box on you. Wounds that heal naturally leave scars people notice.

options.name: The Thing That Follows
options.text: Something bound to the curse, such as a spirit, a voidling, or a dead rival, keeps finding you. The Storyteller brings it into every story arc.

options.name: Creeping Doom
options.text: The curse is slowly winning. The Storyteller marks a tally each session. When it fills, something terrible happens, such as a death, a transformation, or a great loss, unless the curse is broken first.

options.name: One Favor Owed
options.text: Once per story arc, your patron can call in a favor. Until you do it, your power does not work.

options.name: The Price of Use
options.text: Each use of the power costs 1 Willpower.

options.name: The Tithe
options.text: Your patron feeds on you. Your Mana Pool is 3 lower.

options.name: The Bane
options.text: Choose one thing, such as silver, holy ground, running water, or a spoken name. While you touch it or stand in it, the power fails and you take a penalty die on everything.

options.name: Soul Collateral
options.text: Your soul belongs to your patron. If you die, you cannot be Resurrected without the patron's consent, and the patron always names a price.

options.name: The Contract Comes Due
options.text: The bargain has an end date set with your Storyteller. When it arrives, you pay in full or lose the power forever, and the patron comes to collect.

guilds.name: Adventurers Guild
guilds.what: Delvers, monster hunters, and explorers. Runs job boards, outposts, and bounties throughout the world.

guilds.name: Arts Guild
guilds.what: Performers, artists, writers, and entertainers, from street musicians to CCN stars.

guilds.name: Farmers Guild
guilds.what: Growers, ranchers, and food producers who feed Monsera and its trade partners.

guilds.name: Hero Rangers Corps (HRC)
guilds.what: Monsera's military corps against the Rift and its Kaiju, with outposts in every nation. Standing is your Corps rank.

guilds.name: Healers Guild
guilds.what: Doctors, clinics, and healing mages, including curse removal and advanced care.

guilds.name: Laborers Guild
guilds.what: Builders, haulers, miners, and the workers who keep the city running.

guilds.name: Mages Guild
guilds.what: Spellcasters, enchanters, and magical researchers. Keepers of the heptagram.

guilds.name: Makers Guild
guilds.what: Smiths, engineers, and crafters of implements, machines, and gear.

guilds.name: Merchants Guild
guilds.what: Traders, shopkeepers, bankers, and the moneyed interests of Monsera.

guilds.name: Navigators Guild
guilds.what: Sailors, pilots, guides, and anyone who moves people and goods across land, sea, and sky.

guilds.name: Thieves Guild (unofficial)
guilds.what: Extralegal and unrepresented, with no cabinet seat. Speaks its own secure dialect, Thieves' Cant. Its members do not advertise their standing.

guilds.name: Mercenaries Guild (space era)
guilds.what: What the Adventurers Guild is on Terrana, the Mercenaries Guild is in space (Chapter 16).

backgrounds.name: Allies
backgrounds.what: Reliable people who will actively help you when asked.

backgrounds.name: Contacts
backgrounds.what: People who feed you information in a chosen field.

backgrounds.name: Fame
backgrounds.what: How widely you are known, and for what.

backgrounds.name: Fixer
backgrounds.what: Someone who works outside normal channels and makes things happen: finding work, solving problems quietly, and connecting people.

backgrounds.name: Followers
backgrounds.what: People personally loyal to you or your cause, not hired staff.

backgrounds.name: Hacker
backgrounds.what: Your skill at getting into and moving through the CCN and the crystal-based systems that run the modern world.

backgrounds.name: Influence
backgrounds.what: Pull within one institution, organization, or power structure, defined at creation.

backgrounds.name: Mentor
backgrounds.what: A more experienced person invested in your growth.

backgrounds.name: Nobility
backgrounds.what: You were born into a noble family.

backgrounds.name: Retainers
backgrounds.what: Staff, employees, or trained assistants in your service.

backgrounds.name: Safe House
backgrounds.what: Secure places to hide, rest, or lie low.

backgrounds.name: Street Cred
backgrounds.what: Respect within a community or scene you define with the Storyteller.

backgrounds.name: Subscribers
backgrounds.what: An engaged audience that follows you on the CCN, as a creator, public figure, or someone whose life simply caught people's attention.

default.name: Skinner's Hands
default.text: You're skilled at field-dressing, skinning, butchering, and knife work (whittling, cutting rope, scraping hides). Add your dots to rolls to skin or harvest a creature. Each success also saves one extra usable part (hide, sinew, horn, or gland).

a.name: Quick Hands
a.text: Drawing or swapping to a short blade costs no AP. Add your dots to initiative if you start combat with one in hand.

b.name: Find the Gap
b.text: Add your dots to attack rolls against a target that hasn't acted yet this round.

default.name: Throwing Edge
default.text: You can throw any short blade using this Style's Primary pool, at a target up to double your Strength in zones away. It works outside a fight too, to hunt small game or cut a rope.

a.name: Twin Grip
a.text: Wield a short blade in each hand. When you attack with both, add your dots to that one attack roll.

b.name: Pin and Run
b.text: When a thrown blade hits, spend 1 AP to pin the target's clothing or foot. They're Rooted until the end of their next turn.

default.name: Hidden Steel
default.text: You get one extra Belt slot (slot 4), which can only hold short blades. Drawing from it costs no AP. Add your dots to rolls to keep a blade hidden when you're searched.

a.name: Opening Cut
a.text: On a hit, spend 1 AP to give the target Bleeding, at a rating equal to your dots.

b.name: Slip Away
b.text: After you make a melee attack, move 1 zone for free.

default.name: Butcher's Eye
default.text: One look tells you how a creature is put together and where it's weak. Add your dots to rolls to cut out poison, treat a wound with a knife, or track something you've wounded.

a.name: Weak Point
a.text: Once per round, a short blade hit has Armor Penetration equal to half your dots.

b.name: Dancer's Step
b.text: Add your dots to defense rolls against an adjacent enemy you've hit this round.

default.name: Fan of Knives
default.text: One thrown attack can target up to three creatures within throwing range, using one attack roll.

a.name: Second Strike
a.text: If your attack roll beats the target's defense by 3 or more successes, add your dots to the damage.

b.name: Ghost Step
b.text: Once per round, when your defense roll beats an adjacent attack, make a Counter with a short blade, then move 1 zone for free.

default.name: Unseen Approach
default.text: Add your dots to Stealth rolls. Your first hit on a target that hasn't noticed you counts as meeting the next-higher damage threshold.

a.name: Severing Strike
a.text: A called shot that hits a limb gives the target -2 dice on rolls using that limb for the rest of the scene.

b.name: Breath Cut
b.text: Spend 2 AP: on a hit, the target also loses 2 AP on their next turn.

default.name: Every Edge Is Mine
default.text: Anything with an edge or point (a glass shard, a broken sword, a sharpened spoon) counts as a short blade for you, with a Rating equal to your dots.

a.name: Death of a Thousand Cuts
a.text: Spend 3 AP: one attack roll against every enemy in all adjacent zones. Each one you hit also gets Bleeding, at a rating equal to your dots.

b.name: The Last Mercy
b.text: Once per story, a hit on a target at their -4 wound penalty or worse automatically meets their ADT.

default.name: Sword Sense
default.text: One look tells you a blade's quality, balance, and maker, and you can sharpen, maintain, and care for any sword. Add your dots to rolls to appraise or repair a blade.

a.name: Clean Line
a.text: Add your dots to an attack roll made right after moving 1 zone.

b.name: High Guard
b.text: Add your dots to defense rolls on any round you don't attack.

default.name: The Salute
default.text: You know the dueling customs of Terrana's sword schools. A formal challenge from you has to be openly answered or openly refused. Add your dots to social rolls about duels, honor, and exhibition bouts.

a.name: Riposte
a.text: Once per round, when your defense roll beats an adjacent melee attack, make a Counter.

b.name: Bind
b.text: On a hit, spend 1 AP to tie up the target's weapon. Their next attack roll takes a flat penalty die.

default.name: Versatile Grip
default.text: Switch between a one-handed and two-handed grip for free. Two-handed, add half your dots to damage. One-handed, your other hand is free for a shield or an item.

a.name: Twin Blades
a.text: Wield a long blade in each hand. When you attack with both, add your dots to that one attack roll.

b.name: Disarming Edge
b.text: On a hit, spend 1 AP to make the target drop their weapon into an adjacent zone.

default.name: Named Strike
default.text: Name your signature cut. Once per scene, add your dots to its damage. Anyone who has seen it before recognizes your school, which helps your reputation and ruins disguises.

a.name: Crossing Cut
a.text: One attack roll against two adjacent enemies.

b.name: Perfect Parry
b.text: Once per scene, a failed defense roll against a melee attack counts as a success.

default.name: Duelist's Name
default.text: Anyone who knows sword work knows you. Add your dots to social rolls to impress or intimidate them.

a.name: Blade Dance
a.text: Spend 2 AP: one attack roll against every enemy in all adjacent zones.

b.name: Unbroken Rhythm
b.text: Once you've hit the same target three times in a row this scene, add your dots to all your attack and defense rolls against them for the rest of the scene.

default.name: Cut the Unseen
default.text: Your blade can strike and harm incorporeal and conjured things as if they were solid, and can cut what usually can't be cut (smoke-forms, webs of spun magic).

a.name: Unseen Line
a.text: Once per scene, the target can't add bonus dice from any source to their defense against this attack.

b.name: Return Stroke
b.text: When your defense roll beats a melee attack by 3 or more successes, make a Counter. This is in addition to any other Counter you have.

default.name: Master of the School
default.text: You're recognized as a sword master. You may found a school, and anyone who trained under you can call on your name.

a.name: One Thousand Schools
a.text: Spend 3 AP: move up to 2 zones and make one attack roll against every enemy you pass adjacent to. End in any empty zone along your path.

b.name: One Perfect Cut
b.text: Once per story, a hit that meets BDT counts as meeting ADT.

default.name: Woodsman's Grip
default.text: You can fell trees, split logs, clear brush, and build simple shelters and fires in half the usual time with an axe. Add your dots to rolls to cut through wood, doors, or barricades.

a.name: Heavy Hands
a.text: Add your dots to damage while wielding an axe in two hands.

b.name: Hook and Pull
b.text: On a hit, spend 1 AP to hook the target with your axe head. Either pull them 1 zone toward you into an empty zone, or yank their shield aside so they lose its Armor bonus until their next turn.

default.name: Toss the Hatchet
default.text: You can throw hatchets and hand axes using this Style's Primary pool, up to 2 zones.

a.name: Shield Breaker
a.text: A hit on a shield-bearer lowers that shield's Armor bonus by 1 for the rest of the scene. This stacks.

b.name: Second Wind
b.text: After you take damage, spend 1 AP to add your dots to your next attack roll this round.

default.name: Battle Rhythm
default.text: Woodchopping contests, lumberjack feats, work songs, war chants. Add your dots to rolls for feats of strength, or to keep a work crew or war band moving.

a.name: Cleave
a.text: One attack roll against your target and one other adjacent enemy.

b.name: Momentum
b.text: If you only moved last round and didn't attack, add your dots to this round's attack roll.

default.name: Splitter
default.text: Your axe has full Armor Penetration against doors, barricades, wooden walls, and other objects. One hit breaks open an ordinary wooden door.

a.name: Armor Breaker
a.text: On a hit, the target's Armor drops by 1 for the rest of the scene. This stacks.

b.name: Rooted Stance
b.text: Add your dots to rolls to resist being pushed, knocked Prone, or Rooted.

default.name: Woodsman's Legacy
default.text: With an axe and timber, you can build a raft, a palisade, or a footbridge in a few hours instead of days.

a.name: Wide Arc
a.text: Spend 2 AP: one attack roll against every enemy in all adjacent zones.

b.name: Bone Breaker
b.text: A called shot that hits a limb gives the target -2 dice on rolls using that limb until it's healed.

default.name: Unstoppable Swing
default.text: Once per scene, an attack has full Armor Penetration.

a.name: Felling Blow
a.text: A hit that meets LDT also knocks the target Prone.

b.name: Berserker's Due
b.text: While you're at your -2 wound penalty or worse, add your dots to damage.

default.name: Timber
default.text: One swing fells anything that grew or was built from wood: a gate, an old tree, a ship's mast. Outside combat this takes no time at all. In combat it costs 3 AP.

a.name: The Woodsman's Judgment
a.text: Spend 3 AP: one attack roll against every enemy in all adjacent zones. Everyone you hit is knocked Prone.

b.name: World Splitter
b.text: Once per story, a hit has full Armor Penetration and counts as meeting the next-higher damage threshold. The target's weapon or shield also breaks.

default.name: Reach
default.text: With a polearm, you can attack targets up to 2 zones away, not only adjacent ones.

a.name: Herder's Staff
a.text: Add your dots to rolls to herd animals, fish with a spear, or test ice, mud, or deep water ahead of you.

b.name: Held Line
b.text: Add your dots to attack rolls against an enemy who moved into your reach this round.

default.name: Pole Vault
default.text: Once per round, vault on your polearm to move 1 extra zone. You can clear a gap, a low wall, or a Prone body this way.

a.name: Sweep
a.text: A low strike knocks the target Prone instead of dealing damage.

b.name: Push Back
b.text: A hit also pushes the target 1 zone away from you.

default.name: Standard Bearer
default.text: A banner on your polearm draws people to you. Add your dots to rolls to lead, signal, or hold a group together.

a.name: Set Against the Charge
a.text: When an enemy who moved this round attacks you, add your dots to your defense roll. If your defense beats their attack, make a Counter.

b.name: Cutting Line
b.text: One attack roll against two enemies in a straight line within your reach.

default.name: Phalanx
default.text: You and any adjacent ally holding a polearm or shield each add half your dots to defense rolls.

a.name: Pin
a.text: On a hit, spend 1 AP to leave the target Rooted until the end of their next turn.

b.name: Whirling Guard
b.text: On a round you don't attack, make one defense roll, adding your dots, and use it against every melee attack made on you that round.

default.name: Long Reach
default.text: Your Reach extends to 3 zones.

a.name: Lever and Lift
a.text: Use your polearm as a lever or pole. Add your dots to rolls to pry open gates, lift a portcullis, or knock down something high.

b.name: Zone Denial
b.text: An enemy within your reach has to spend 1 extra AP for each zone it moves away from you.

default.name: Unyielding
default.text: An enemy you've hit this round can't push you, Root you, or knock you Prone.

a.name: Line Breaker
a.text: Spend 2 AP: one attack roll against every enemy in a straight line out to the end of your reach.

b.name: Piercing Thrust
b.text: A hit on a Rooted or Prone target has full Armor Penetration.

default.name: Heron's Patience
default.text: You can stand perfectly still for hours. You notice anything that moves within your reach, even while resting, and it can't catch you by surprise. Add your dots to Awareness rolls.

a.name: The Unbroken Spear
a.text: Spend 3 AP: one attack roll against every enemy within your reach.

b.name: Sky Piercer
b.text: Once per story, throw your polearm like a javelin at any target you can see. It hits automatically and counts as meeting the next-higher damage threshold.

default.name: Watchful Guard
default.text: Bodyguard work, sentry duty, watching a camp. Add your dots to Awareness rolls to spot threats to someone you're protecting.

a.name: Sturdy Stance
a.text: While holding a shield on a round you don't attack, add half your dots to your BDT.

b.name: Shield Bash
b.text: Attack with your shield using this Style's Primary pool. A hit pushes the target 1 zone away.

default.name: Cover Ally
default.text: Spend 1 AP: an adjacent ally adds your dots to their next defense roll this round.

a.name: Hold the Line
a.text: Add your dots to rolls to resist being pushed, knocked Prone, or moved.

b.name: Arrow Catcher
b.text: Add your dots to defense rolls against ranged attacks.

default.name: Shield Wall
default.text: While an adjacent ally also holds a shield, you both add half your dots to your BDT.

a.name: Turtle
a.text: On a round you take no Action, make one defense roll, adding your dots, and use it against every attack made on you that round.

b.name: Dent the Plate
b.text: A hit with your shield lowers the target's Armor by 1 for the rest of the scene. This stacks.

default.name: Steady the Line
default.text: Add your dots to rolls to lead a defense. Adjacent allies add your dots to rolls to resist fear.

a.name: Counter Bash
a.text: Once per round, when your defense roll beats a melee attack, make a Counter with your shield.

b.name: Interpose
b.text: Once per round, when an adjacent ally is hit, you take the hit instead, and your BDT applies.

default.name: Shield Throw
default.text: Throw your shield using this Style's Primary pool, up to 3 zones. A hit pushes the target 1 zone. The shield rebounds to your hand at the start of your next turn.

a.name: Unbreakable Guard
a.text: Once per scene, a hit that would meet your LDT counts as meeting only your BDT.

b.name: Bulwark
b.text: Cover Ally now protects every adjacent ally for the same 1 AP.

default.name: Ride the Shield
default.text: Ride your shield down a slope, snowbank, or staircase, or float on it as a small raft. In combat, one adjacent ally behind it adds your dots to defense rolls against ranged attacks.

a.name: Ram
a.text: Move up to 2 zones in a straight line and make one attack roll against the first enemy you reach. On a hit they're pushed 1 zone and knocked Prone.

b.name: Ricochet Throw
b.text: Your Shield Throw can hit two targets with one attack roll, bouncing from one to the other.

default.name: Living Wall
default.text: An enemy has to spend 1 extra AP to move into any zone adjacent to you.

a.name: The Last Wall
a.text: For the rest of the scene, you can redirect any attack against an adjacent ally onto yourself, adding your dots to your defense roll against it.

b.name: Unbroken
b.text: Once per story, while you hold your shield, you can't be Incapacitated this scene. Damage that would Incapacitate you leaves your last Health box empty instead.

default.name: Iron Chin
default.text: Add your dots to rolls to resist being knocked out, losing AP, or being intimidated by physical threats.

a.name: Jab
a.text: On a hit, spend 1 AP for a second strike on the same target, which they defend against using that same attack roll.

b.name: Bob and Weave
b.text: Add your dots to defense rolls against fists and melee weapons.

default.name: Roadwork
default.text: Running, skipping rope, hours of training. Add your dots to Athletics rolls for long runs and hard exertion. You don't tire from a long march or a chase.

a.name: Body Shot
a.text: A hit also makes the target lose 1 AP on their next turn.

b.name: Guard Up
b.text: While fighting unarmed, add half your dots to your BDT against unarmed attacks.

default.name: Prize Fighter
default.text: Add your dots to rolls to win over a crowd, talk up a fight, or read the odds on one.

a.name: Combination
a.text: If your attack roll beats the target's defense by 3 or more successes, a follow-up punch adds your dots to the damage.

b.name: Cut Off the Ring
b.text: On a hit, the target has to spend 1 extra AP to move away from you on their next turn.

default.name: Cornerman
default.text: You know how to patch up cuts and swelling. Outside combat, each success on your roll heals as Basic healing, Bashing damage only.

a.name: Haymaker
a.text: Spend 1 AP to add your dots to damage. If you miss, take a flat penalty die on defense rolls until your next turn.

b.name: Counterpuncher
b.text: Once per round, when your defense roll beats an adjacent attack, make a Counter.

default.name: Granite Jaw
default.text: Your Bashing wound penalties count one step lower (-1 becomes none, -2 becomes -1, -4 becomes -2).

a.name: Liver Shot
a.text: On a hit, the target takes a flat penalty die on every roll until the end of their next turn.

b.name: Barrage
b.text: Spend 2 AP: one attack roll strikes the same target three times, and they defend against it three times.

default.name: Ring Sense
default.text: Add your dots to initiative. No one within 2 zones of you can catch you by surprise.

a.name: Knockout Blow
a.text: A called shot to the head that hits makes the target lose 3 AP on their next turn.

b.name: Rope-a-Dope
b.text: Each attack that misses you this round adds 1 die to your next attack roll, up to your dots.

default.name: Champion's Belt
default.text: Add your dots to social rolls anywhere fighting is respected. Once per story, you can declare a fight a sanctioned bout, and most people will honor its rules.

a.name: Final Bell
a.text: Spend 3 AP: one attack roll strikes the same target a number of times equal to your dots, and they defend against each strike separately.

b.name: Down for the Count
b.text: Once per story, a hit that meets LDT on a target at their -2 wound penalty or worse knocks them out (Incapacitated).

default.name: Flowing Breath
default.text: Add your dots to rolls to resist pain, fear, or exhaustion, using breathing and meditation.

a.name: Redirect
a.text: Once per round, when your defense roll beats an adjacent melee attack, send the attacker stumbling 1 zone in any direction you choose, into an empty zone.

b.name: Still Water
b.text: Once per round, after a successful defense roll, move 1 zone for free.

default.name: Silk Step
default.text: Add your dots to Acrobatics rolls. You can run along a wall for 1 zone, cross narrow ledges at full speed, and jump 1 extra zone.

a.name: Deflecting Palm
a.text: Add your dots to defense rolls against ranged attacks.

b.name: Sweeping Kick
b.text: A low kick knocks the target Prone instead of dealing damage.

default.name: Feather Fall
default.text: For falling damage, count every fall as shorter by a number of zones (10 feet each) equal to your dots.

a.name: Pressure Point
a.text: On a hit, spend 1 AP: the target takes a flat penalty die on rolls using one limb for the rest of the scene.

b.name: Locking Hand
b.text: On a hit, spend 1 AP to leave the target Rooted until the end of their next turn.

default.name: Empty Hand
default.text: While unarmed, add your dots to defense rolls against armed enemies.

a.name: Counting River
a.text: On a hit, strike the same target a second time for free. They defend against that same attack roll.

b.name: Borrowed Force
b.text: Once per round, when your defense roll beats an adjacent melee attack, make a Counter. Add the attacker's weapon Rating to its damage.

default.name: Monk's Discipline
default.text: You can go without food or sleep for a number of days equal to your dots with no penalty.

a.name: Leaf on the Wind
a.text: Once per scene, a failed defense roll counts as a success.

b.name: Rising Kick
b.text: Leap 1 zone and attack. A hit knocks the target Prone.

default.name: One Inch Strike
default.text: Add your dots to the damage of any strike you make without moving that round.

a.name: Mountain Stillness
a.text: On a round you don't move, every attack against you takes a flat penalty die.

b.name: Snatch the Arrow
b.text: Once per round, when your defense roll beats a thrown or fired attack, catch it and send it back as a Counter at any target in sight.

default.name: Leaf Walking
default.text: Each round, you can cross a number of zones equal to your dots over water, leaves, or branches too thin to hold you.

a.name: The Thousand Hand Form
a.text: Spend 3 AP: one attack roll against every enemy in all adjacent zones, then move 1 zone for free.

b.name: Enlightened Palm
b.text: Once per story, one unarmed strike has full Armor Penetration and full Magic Penetration, and counts as meeting the next-higher damage threshold.

default.name: Crowd Favorite
default.text: An entrance, a taunt, a pose. Add your dots to rolls to work a crowd, intimidate someone before a fight, or sell a story.

a.name: Lock Up
a.text: On an unarmed hit, spend 1 AP: the target is Grappled by you instead of taking damage.

b.name: Body Slam
b.text: On an unarmed hit, the target is also knocked Prone.

default.name: Steel Chair
default.text: Improvised objects (chairs, bottles, ladders, tables) count as proper weapons for you. Add half your dots to their damage.

a.name: Clothesline
a.text: If you moved at least 1 zone before attacking, a hit adds your dots to damage and knocks the target Prone.

b.name: Sleeper Hold
b.text: While you have someone Grappled, every Upkeep they fail to break free, they lose 2 AP that turn.

default.name: Kayfabe
default.text: You can fake a fight, a fall, or an injury well enough to fool anyone watching. Add your dots to Chicanery or Subterfuge rolls to stage anything physical.

a.name: Suplex
a.text: While grappling, spend 1 AP to slam your target: damage equal to your dots, the target is knocked Prone, and the grapple ends.

b.name: Dropkick
b.text: Leap 1 zone and attack. A hit pushes the target 1 zone. If you miss, you land Prone.

default.name: No-Sell
default.text: Once per scene, shrug off a hit. It counts as meeting one threshold lower (LDT becomes BDT; BDT does no damage).

a.name: Figure-Four Leglock
a.text: Every Upkeep your target stays Grappled by you, they take damage equal to your dots. When they break free, they're Rooted until the end of their next turn.

b.name: DDT
b.text: While grappling, spend 1 AP: damage equal to your dots, the target loses 2 AP on their next turn, and the grapple ends.

default.name: Face of the Match
default.text: Fans and rivals know your name. Add your dots to social rolls with anyone who loves a good fight. Once per story, call in a favor from a fan.

a.name: Piledriver
a.text: While grappling, spend 2 AP: damage equal to twice your dots, the target is knocked Prone, and the grapple ends.

b.name: Powerbomb
b.text: While grappling, spend 2 AP to throw your target 1 zone into another enemy. One attack roll against both. Everyone hit is knocked Prone, and the grapple ends.

default.name: Off the Top Rope
default.text: From any height (a table, a balcony, a ledge), dive onto a target up to 2 zones away. Add your dots to the attack roll. You take no falling damage from the dive.

a.name: Chokeslam
a.text: Spend 2 AP: lift an adjacent target and slam them down. Damage equal to your dots, they're knocked Prone, and they lose 2 AP on their next turn. No grapple needed.

b.name: Signature Move
b.text: Name your finisher. Once per scene, a successful Grapple on a target at their -4 wound penalty or worse ends their fight: they submit or are knocked out (Incapacitated).

default.name: Undisputed Champion
default.text: Once per story, declare a bout a title match. For the rest of the scene, you can't be pinned, made to submit, or knocked out by non-lethal means.

a.name: The Finish
a.text: While grappling, spend 3 AP: damage equal to three times your dots, counted as meeting the next-higher damage threshold. The grapple ends.

b.name: Tag Team
b.text: When an adjacent ally attacks a target you have Grappled, they add your dots to their attack roll.

default.name: Hunter's Eye
default.text: Add your dots to rolls to track, stalk, or read animal sign.

a.name: Steady Draw
a.text: Add your dots to attack rolls made without moving that round.

b.name: Ready Nock
b.text: Add your dots to initiative while holding a bow.

default.name: Fletcher's Craft
default.text: You can make arrows and string bows from raw materials, about a quiver's worth of arrows in an hour.

a.name: Pinning Shot
a.text: On a hit, spend 1 AP to leave the target Rooted until the end of their next turn.

b.name: Cover Shot
b.text: Spend 1 AP: an ally within your range adds your dots to their next defense roll.

default.name: Quiver Belt
default.text: You get one extra Belt slot (slot 4), for special arrows only. Drawing from it costs no AP.

a.name: Arcing Shot
a.text: Ignore cover. You can also hit a target you can't see if an ally can see it.

b.name: Silent Shot
b.text: Shooting doesn't give away your position if you're hidden. Add your dots to Stealth rolls right after a shot.

default.name: Trick Arrows
default.text: You know how to rig rope arrows (a line between two zones that anyone can cross), smoke, noisemakers, and blunt arrows that deal kinetic damage.

a.name: Marksman's Patience
a.text: Spend your whole Action aiming. Your next shot adds twice your dots to the attack roll.

b.name: Twin Nock
b.text: One attack roll against two targets within range.

default.name: Long Eye
default.text: Ignore the -2 dice penalty for half cover.

a.name: Volley
a.text: Spend 2 AP: one attack roll against a target zone and every zone adjacent to it.

b.name: Heart Seeker
b.text: A called shot to a vital spot has full Armor Penetration.

default.name: Eagle Eye
default.text: You see clearly at great distances, enough to read a sign a mile away.

a.name: Splitting Shot
a.text: When you hit, the arrow keeps going and also hits the next creature in a straight line behind the target, using the same attack roll.

b.name: The Last Arrow
b.text: Once per scene, re-roll a missed shot at your full pool.

default.name: Wind's Voice
default.text: You always know what the wind and weather will do. Your arrows ignore penalties from wind, weather, and magical concealment.

a.name: The Thousand Arrow Storm
a.text: Spend 3 AP: one attack roll against every enemy you can see within range.

b.name: One True Shot
b.text: Once per story, an arrow automatically hits anything you can see and meets its ADT.

default.name: Gunsmith's Hands
default.text: You can clean, maintain, and repair hand guns and cast your own bullets. Add your dots to rolls to fix or identify firearms.

a.name: Fast Draw
a.text: Drawing a holstered hand gun costs no AP. Add your dots to initiative while one is holstered.

b.name: Point Blank
b.text: Add your dots to damage against an adjacent target.

default.name: Trick Shooting
default.text: Coins in the air, candle wicks, bottles off a fence. Add your dots to rolls to show off your shooting.

a.name: Double Tap
a.text: One attack roll fires twice at one target, and they defend against it twice.

b.name: Hip Fire
b.text: Add your dots to attack rolls made after moving that round.

default.name: Speed Loader
default.text: You get one extra Belt slot (slot 4), for ammunition only. Reloading from it costs no AP.

a.name: Disarm Shot
a.text: A called shot to the hand or weapon that hits makes the target drop it into an adjacent zone.

b.name: Covering Fire
b.text: Spend 1 AP: an ally within your range adds your dots to their next defense roll.

default.name: Two Guns
default.text: Wield a hand gun in each hand. When you fire both, add your dots to that one attack roll.

a.name: Ricochet
a.text: Bank a shot off a hard surface to ignore cover.

b.name: Gunslinger's Volley
b.text: One attack roll against two targets within range.

default.name: Reputation
default.text: Your name gets around saloons and frontier towns. Add your dots to rolls to intimidate, and most people think twice before drawing on you.

a.name: Fan the Hammer
a.text: Spend 2 AP: one attack roll fires up to three times, at any mix of targets in range. Each shot is defended separately.

b.name: Dead Eye
b.text: A called shot to a vital spot that hits counts as meeting the next-higher damage threshold.

default.name: Showdown
default.text: You win every initiative tie, and you act before any enemy you can see who starts combat with a weapon holstered.

a.name: Empty the Chamber
a.text: Once per scene, spend all your remaining AP on one shot at one target, adding twice your dots to the damage.

b.name: Last Stand
b.text: While you're at your -2 wound penalty or worse, add your dots to attack rolls.

default.name: Bullet Time
default.text: Once per scene, act for one turn as if you had the full 6 AP.

a.name: The Last Gunslinger
a.text: Spend 3 AP: one attack roll against every enemy you can see within range.

b.name: One Bullet, One Truth
b.text: Once per story, a shot automatically hits anything you can see and meets its ADT.

default.name: Gunner's Hands
default.text: You can haul, mount, and maintain heavy weapons, and you carry a large gun without slowing down.

a.name: Brace
a.text: Add your dots to attack rolls made without moving that round.

b.name: Scope In
b.text: Add your dots to called shots.

default.name: Demolition Sense
default.text: Add your dots to rolls to find structural weak points, where to breach a wall, or the best firing position.

a.name: Suppressing Fire
a.text: Spend 1 AP: one attack roll at a target zone and every zone adjacent to it. It deals no damage, but every enemy there takes a flat penalty die on their next roll, whether you hit or not.

b.name: Knockback
b.text: A hit pushes the target 1 zone away.

default.name: Ammo Belt
default.text: You get one extra Belt slot (slot 4), for ammunition only. Reloading from it costs no AP.

a.name: Armor Piercing
a.text: Your shots have Armor Penetration equal to half your dots.

b.name: Field Repair
b.text: Clear a jam or fix a damaged gun for 1 AP in combat. Outside combat, add your dots to repair rolls.

default.name: Dug In
default.text: On a round you don't move, add half your dots to your BDT against ranged attacks.

a.name: Wide Blast
a.text: One attack roll against every zone directly and diagonally forward of you.

b.name: Long Shot
b.text: Your shots punch through thin cover such as wood, plaster, or a thin wall: a target with full cover behind it has only half cover.

default.name: Quartermaster's Eye
default.text: One look at an enemy camp tells you roughly their numbers, gear, and supplies.

a.name: Breach
a.text: A shot destroys a door, a section of wooden wall, or one piece of cover.

b.name: Walking Fire
b.text: Spend 2 AP: one attack roll against every enemy in a straight line within range.

default.name: Unshakeable
default.text: On a round you don't move, enemy effects can't push you, knock you Prone, or make you lose AP.

a.name: Devastator
a.text: A hit lowers the target's Armor by 2 for the rest of the scene.

b.name: Scorched Line
b.text: Once per round, a shot at a target you've already hit this scene has full Armor Penetration.

default.name: One-Man Battery
default.text: You can load, aim, and fire siege weapons (cannons, ballistae) alone, with no crew.

a.name: The Siege Breaker
a.text: Spend 3 AP: one attack roll against every enemy within 2 zones of a target zone. All cover in that area is destroyed.

b.name: Last Belt
b.text: Once per story, one attack automatically hits every enemy in your line of sight and meets at least their LDT.

default.name: Natural Arsenal
default.text: Your natural weapons count as a weapon with a Rating equal to half your dots, rounded up, unless your Heritage Magic gives them a better one. They can't be dropped or disarmed.

a.name: Rake
a.text: Attack with two natural weapons at once, such as both claws or a claw and a bite. Add your dots to that one attack roll.

b.name: Pounce
b.text: Add your dots to an attack roll made right after moving at least 1 zone.

default.name: Climbing Claws
default.text: Add your dots to climbing rolls. You can climb wood, stone, or ice with no gear.

a.name: Rend
a.text: On a hit, spend 1 AP to give the target Bleeding.

b.name: Latch On
b.text: On a hit, spend 1 AP: the target is Grappled by you. While you hold them, you can still attack them with your other natural weapons.

default.name: Ram
default.text: Move up to 2 zones in a straight line and strike the first enemy you reach with your horns, head, or body. A hit pushes them 1 zone away. You end in an empty zone.

a.name: Feral Frenzy
a.text: Each hit on the same target this round adds 1 die to your next attack roll against them, up to your dots.

b.name: Sweep
b.text: A tail, a wing, or a low swipe knocks the target Prone instead of dealing damage.

default.name: Thick Hide
default.text: While you wear no armor, add half your dots to your BDT.

a.name: Hamstring
a.text: A called shot to a leg that hits leaves the target Rooted until the end of their next turn, and they spend 1 extra AP to move for the rest of the scene.

b.name: Gore
b.text: A Ram that hits with horns, tusks, or fangs also has Armor Penetration equal to half your dots and gives the target Bleeding.

default.name: Apex Presence
default.text: Beasts know a predator when they see one. Add your dots to rolls to intimidate or command animals, and to intimidate anyone who sees your natural weapons bared.

a.name: Whirlwind of Claws
a.text: Spend 2 AP: one attack roll against every enemy in all adjacent zones.

b.name: Savage Maul
b.text: Spend 2 AP: claw, claw, bite. One attack roll strikes the same target three times, and they defend against it three times.

default.name: Spirit Claws
default.text: Your natural weapons can harm incorporeal and conjured things as if they were solid, and they have Magic Penetration equal to half your dots.

a.name: Throat Strike
a.text: A called shot to the throat that hits makes the target lose 2 AP on their next turn, and they can't speak until the end of it.

b.name: Blood Feast
b.text: Once per scene, when a bite meets the target's LDT, heal Bashing damage equal to half your dots.

default.name: Apex Predator
default.text: Creatures of animal intelligence won't attack you unless magic or a master forces them to, and nothing within 3 zones can catch you by surprise.

a.name: The Red Hunt
a.text: Spend 3 AP: move up to 2 zones and make one attack roll against every enemy you pass adjacent to. Everyone you hit also gets Bleeding. End in any empty zone along your path.

b.name: Death Grip
b.text: Once per story, while you have a target Grappled, one bite or claw automatically hits and meets their ADT.

default.name: Heat Tolerance
default.text: Damage you take from ordinary, non-magical heat and flame is halved (rounded down), and you can briefly handle hot coals or metal.

spells.name: Ignite
spells.text: A flick of concentrated heat thrown directly at a target.

spells.name: Kindle
spells.text: The most basic application of fire. Make a thing burn.

default.name: Warmth
default.note: Attuned: holds 1 of your M/T while active
default.text: You and allies in adjacent zones are unaffected by non-magical cold and cannot gain the Chilled condition from weather.

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.text: A reliable aimed bolt. Goes where it is aimed. Burns what it hits.

spells.name: Burning Ground
spells.text: The ground burns. Not intensely. But it burns.

default.name: Reach of Flame
default.text: Your Fire spells with a range of Adjacent zone can target a zone one step further away.

spells.name: Fire Breath
spells.text: A broad expulsion of fire from the caster's hands or mouth.

spells.name: Flame Wall
spells.text: A vertical sheet of fire that punishes anyone who walks through it.

default.name: Flare
default.text: When an enemy in an adjacent zone attacks you, a flash of fire bursts from your body. That attack loses 2 dice.

spells.name: Fire Lash
spells.text: A lash of fire that cuts a straight line through everything in its path.

spells.name: Ember Cloak
spells.text: The caster burns. Anyone who reaches for them learns it immediately.

default.name: Searing
default.text: Damage from your Fire spells ignores 1 point of the armor portion of a target's DT.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.text: The classic. A ball of fire that explodes on impact and covers the area.

spells.name: Piercing Flame
spells.text: Fire focused down to a point of intense penetration.

default.name: Living Flame
default.note: Attuned: holds 2 of your M/T while active
default.text: Your body is wreathed in fire. Any target that hits you with a melee attack gains the Burning condition.

spells.name: Rain of Fire
spells.text: The sky over multiple zones ignites. Everyone below learns at once.

spells.name: Fire Elemental
spells.text: A semi-autonomous entity of concentrated flame that attacks on command.

default.name: Heart of the Sun
default.text: Burning applied by your Fire spells deals 1 Lethal on a successful resistance roll and 1 Aggravated on a failed one.

spells.name: Inferno
spells.text: The world, briefly, is on fire.

spells.name: Eternal Flame
spells.text: A fire that stays. It does not go out. It does not diminish. It simply burns.

knowledges.name: Water
knowledges.focus: Force, cold, and flow. Imposes Chilled; moves targets.

default.name: Water Breathing
default.note: Attuned: holds 1 of your M/T while active
default.text: You can breathe underwater and swim at your normal movement.

spells.name: Water Bolt
spells.text: Water moving very fast in one direction. It hits hard.

spells.name: Chill Touch
spells.text: Cold applied directly. Not violence yet. Just cold.

default.name: Purify
default.text: Make up to a zone of water clean and safe to drink, or draw a few gallons of fresh water out of the air.

spells.name: Water Jet
spells.text: A stream of water that pushes as hard as it hits.

spells.name: Ice Patch
spells.text: The floor gets slick. The transition from upright to down is fast.

default.name: Flowing Form
default.text: You gain 1 bonus die on Dexterity + Dodge rolls against Fire Magic.

spells.name: Frost Lance
spells.text: Cold compressed to a point and thrown. It gets into the target in more ways than one.

spells.name: Water Shield
spells.text: Water intercedes between the caster and whatever is coming.

default.name: Water Walking
default.note: Attuned: holds 2 of your M/T while active
default.text: You can move across the surface of water and other liquids as if it were solid ground.

spells.name: Flash Freeze
spells.text: Sudden total freezing. Not cold. Frozen.

spells.name: Quench
spells.text: Every flame in the zone goes out at once.

default.name: Deep Cold
default.text: A target that gains the Chilled condition from your Water spells also loses their free move while Chilled.

spells.name: Tidal Pull
spells.text: A wave that hits a target and pulls them back with it.

spells.name: Ice Armor
spells.text: Ice plate. It holds until it is melted. Which takes work.

default.name: Slip Away
default.text: When you would be pushed, pulled, or dragged, you flow like water instead. Ignore the forced movement and move 1 zone in a direction of your choice.

spells.name: Blizzard
spells.text: Multiple zones become extremely cold and hostile all at once.

spells.name: Countercurrent
spells.text: An incoming attack gets turned around and aimed somewhere else.

default.name: Absolute Zero
default.text: Frozen conditions from your Water spells can only be ended by Fire Magic that exceeds your cast successes, and a Frozen target cannot use Reactions.

spells.name: Deluge
spells.text: A wave fills everything that can be seen. There is nowhere to go.

spells.name: Glacier
spells.text: A zone becomes a glacier all at once.

knowledges.name: Air
knowledges.focus: Wind, speed, and precision. Ranged attacks and control.

default.name: Light Step
default.text: Treat every fall as one vertical zone shorter when working out falling damage.

spells.name: Wind Strike
spells.text: Wind with a point to it.

spells.name: Gust
spells.text: A targeted push of air with real force behind it.

default.name: Whisper
default.text: Send a short spoken message of a sentence or two on the wind to one person within line of sight. Only they hear it.

spells.name: Air Blade
spells.text: Air made sharp. It cuts.

spells.name: Deflecting Wind
spells.text: A wall of moving air that blows an incoming attack off course.

default.name: Tailwind
default.note: Attuned: holds 2 of your M/T while active
default.text: Your movement increases by 1 zone each turn.

spells.name: Cyclone
spells.text: Everything in front gets blown back.

spells.name: Wind Sprint
spells.text: The wind pushes from behind. The caster moves faster than they should.

default.name: Eye of the Wind
default.text: Your ranged Air spells ignore dice penalties from wind, weather, and non-magical visibility.

spells.name: Tornado Bolt
spells.text: A miniature tornado shot in a line, knocking everyone it touches off their feet.

spells.name: Wind Wall
spells.text: A wall of wind that stops things from passing through it.

default.name: Updraft Leap
default.text: Leap up to 2 vertical zones, or across 2 zones, and land safely.

spells.name: Shearing Gale
spells.text: A gale strong enough to move everything in a zone at once.

spells.name: Fog of War
spells.text: A fog thick enough that ranged targeting becomes near impossible.

default.name: Gale Force
default.text: Targets your Air spells push or Knock Down are pushed 1 additional zone.

spells.name: Updraft Strike
spells.text: Up. Involuntarily.

spells.name: Sustained Flight
spells.text: The air carries the caster. They go where they choose.

default.name: Storm Crown
default.note: Attuned: holds 3 of your M/T while active
default.text: Ranged attacks and targeted spells against you lose dice equal to your Air dots.

spells.name: Grand Cyclone
spells.text: The wind takes everyone somewhere else.

spells.name: Eye of the Storm
spells.text: A permanent storm with a quiet center. The storm belongs to the caster.

knowledges.name: Earth
knowledges.focus: Stone and terrain. Barriers and heavy damage.

default.name: Stonefoot
default.text: You gain 1 bonus die on rolls to resist being pushed, pulled, or Knocked Down.

spells.name: Stone Throw
spells.text: A rock. Thrown with magic. It hits hard.

spells.name: Earthen Shield
spells.text: Earth up in front of the caster. Gone after the attack.

default.name: Shape Stone
default.text: Reshape a small amount of stone or earth by hand: dig a hole, raise a step, seal a crack, or carve a handhold.

spells.name: Rock Barrage
spells.text: Several rocks at once. Still from the ground. Still going where they are aimed.

spells.name: Rubble Field
spells.text: The ground becomes a mess of broken rock. Walking through it is a problem.

default.name: Bedrock
default.text: Earth Magic defensive spells you cast add 1 more to the DT bonus they grant.

spells.name: Stone Spike
spells.text: A spike of rock explodes up from beneath a target's feet.

spells.name: Stone Wall
spells.text: Stone rises between two zones and stays there.

default.name: Tremorsense
default.text: Until the start of the next Upkeep Phase, you know the location of every creature touching the ground in adjacent zones, even hidden ones.

spells.name: Boulder Crash
spells.text: A very large rock applied to a single target with a great deal of force.

spells.name: Tremor
spells.text: The ground shakes. Everyone on it goes down.

default.name: Living Stone
default.note: Attuned: holds 3 of your M/T while active
default.text: Your skin hardens like stone. Your BDT increases by 1.

spells.name: Stoneskin
spells.text: The caster becomes partially stone. They are harder to hurt and harder to ignore.

spells.name: Earthquake
spells.text: The ground around the caster becomes unreliable all at once.

default.name: Unyielding Ground
default.text: Difficult terrain created by your Earth spells costs enemies 1 additional AP to move through, and you and your allies ignore it.

spells.name: Meteor Strike
spells.text: A great deal of earth falls on a great deal of people at once.

spells.name: Stone Fortress
spells.text: A stone fort rises from the ground in a turn. The caster is inside it.

default.name: Mountain's Weight
default.text: A target Knocked Down by your Earth spells is also Rooted until their next Upkeep Phase.

spells.name: Continental Shift
spells.text: The caster moves the world. Only a little. It is enough.

spells.name: Earth Titan
spells.text: The caster stops being a person and starts being a problem.

knowledges.name: Nature
knowledges.focus: Growth, vines, and spores. Roots, terrain, damage over time.

default.name: Forest Sense
default.text: You gain 1 bonus die on Survival rolls in natural wilderness, and you can always identify a plant and what it does.

spells.name: Thorn Shot
spells.text: A thorn. Much faster than normal thorns.

spells.name: Entangle
spells.text: Vines grab a target and hold on.

default.name: Bloom
default.text: Make a plant grow a full season in moments: ripen fruit, sprout a seed into a sapling, or spread a vine across a wall.

spells.name: Vine Whip
spells.text: A vine that reaches and pulls.

spells.name: Spore Burst
spells.text: A burst of organic poison. Invisible. Persistent.

default.name: Thornhide
default.note: Attuned: holds 2 of your M/T while active
default.text: Thorns grow along your skin and clothing. Any target that hits you with a melee attack takes 1 damage.

spells.name: Thorn Barrage
spells.text: A wide spray of thorns. Messy. Effective.

spells.name: Vine Curtain
spells.text: A wall of vines that would rather hold than block.

default.name: Deep Roots
default.text: Targets Rooted by your Nature spells need 1 additional success to break free.

spells.name: Constricting Roots
spells.text: Roots that seize and keep tightening.

spells.name: Overgrowth Zone
spells.text: The zone becomes a problem for anyone who needs to move through it.

default.name: Plant Memory
default.text: Touch a plant and ask it what it witnessed in the last day. It answers with simple impressions of who passed and what happened.

spells.name: Barrage of Thorns
spells.text: The entire zone becomes hostile ground.

spells.name: Green Passage
spells.text: Branches part. Roots settle. The forest lets you through.

default.name: Virulence
default.text: Poisoned conditions from your Nature spells start with a damage value 2 higher.

spells.name: Grove of Thorns
spells.text: A spreading thicket that grabs and holds everything it can reach.

spells.name: Living Armor
spells.text: The caster is wrapped in something alive. It grows back when damaged.

default.name: Verdant Path
default.note: Attuned: holds 4 of your M/T while active
default.text: Plants surge up wherever you walk. Each zone you leave becomes difficult terrain for enemies until the start of the next Upkeep Phase.

spells.name: World Tree
spells.text: A tree grows. Immediately and everywhere. The battlefield adapts to the tree.

spells.name: Blight
spells.text: Everything green dies. The people in it follow.

knowledges.name: Bright
knowledges.focus: Radiance. Harms undead, buffs the living, transfers mana.

default.name: Sense Undead
default.text: You always know when undead are in adjacent zones, even when they are hidden.

spells.name: Radiant Bolt
spells.text: A flash of radiant energy. For most people, harmless. For undead, not.

spells.name: Glow
spells.text: The shadows have nowhere left to sit.

default.name: Halo
default.note: Attuned: holds 1 of your M/T while active
default.text: A soft light surrounds you. Non-magical darkness has no effect on you, and you can light your surroundings at will.

spells.name: Light Ray
spells.text: Radiant energy with reach. It strips shadow from what it touches.

spells.name: Blessing
spells.text: A sustained radiant enhancement that makes one kind of task easier.

default.name: Radiance
default.text: Your Bright attacks against undead ignore 1 point of the armor portion of their DT.

spells.name: Holy Burst
spells.text: A burst of holy light that sweeps a cone of undead targets.

spells.name: Beacon
spells.text: A light so bright it feels like courage.

default.name: Inspire
default.text: An ally in an adjacent zone gains 1 bonus die on their next roll this turn.

spells.name: Radiant Wave
spells.text: The zone flares with radiant energy. Everything undead in it learns.

spells.name: Mana Transfer
spells.cost: 4 (spent by the caster; the amount transferred is separate)
spells.text: The caster opens a channel and lets mana flow. The only Bright ability that can do this.

default.name: Purity
default.text: You gain bonus dice equal to half your Bright dots (rounded up) on resistance rolls against Shade Magic.

spells.name: Smite
spells.text: Radiant energy that hits an undead target with twice the force. Then strips their shadows.

spells.name: Turn Undead
spells.text: The dead remember, for a moment, that they were meant to rest.

default.name: Aura of Dawn
default.note: Attuned: holds 3 of your M/T while active
default.text: Undead in zones adjacent to you lose 1 die on attack rolls.

spells.name: Consecration
spells.text: The zone is consecrated. The undead feel it immediately.

spells.name: Radiant Pillar
spells.text: Light falls everywhere at once. Every undead target in sight is addressed.

default.name: Sanctified
default.text: When your Bright Magic opposes or dispels Shade Magic, your successes count double.

spells.name: Final Light
spells.text: There is no getting back up from this.

spells.name: Holy Ground
spells.text: The entire visible world is consecrated simultaneously. Undead cannot stand in it.

knowledges.name: Shade
knowledges.focus: Darkness and drain. Harms the living, buffs undead, drains mana.

default.name: Darksight
default.text: You see in non-magical darkness as if it were lit.

spells.name: Shadow Bolt
spells.text: Shadow with force behind it. The living feel it.

spells.name: Dim
spells.text: The light goes. Not all at once. But enough.

default.name: Hush
default.text: Every sound you make is muffled until the start of the next Upkeep Phase. You gain 2 bonus dice on Stealth rolls during that time.

spells.name: Corruption Bolt
spells.text: Shadow that drains as well as damages.

spells.name: Shadow Cloak
spells.text: Shadows gather around the caster. They are harder to see. Harder to target.

default.name: Lingering Dark
default.text: Darkness from your Shade spells can only be dispelled by Bright Magic that exceeds your cast successes.

spells.name: Shadow Spike
spells.text: Shadow that leaves a mark harder to heal than ordinary wounds.

spells.name: Fog of Dread
spells.text: The darkness fills the zone and stays. The living find it draining.

default.name: Veil
default.note: Attuned: holds 2 of your M/T while active
default.text: While you are in a Dimmed or Darkened zone, you gain bonus dice equal to your Shade dots on Stealth rolls.

spells.name: Ethereal Shade
spells.text: A layer of shadow that limits how fast a living target can recover magic.

spells.name: Shadow Step
spells.text: Where there is shadow, the caster can be.

default.name: Grave Whisper
default.text: Touch a corpse and ask it one question. It answers with what it knew in life, in as few words as possible.

spells.name: Mass Drain
spells.text: Shadow that reaches all living targets in a zone at once.

spells.name: Animate Dead
spells.text: Something dead gets up. It does what the caster says.

default.name: Hunger
default.text: Living targets that lose mana to your Shade spells lose 1 additional mana.

spells.name: Black Pulse
spells.text: Shadow goes everywhere. Everything living in sight feels it.

spells.name: Permanent Darkness
spells.text: The darkness becomes a permanent feature of the zone.

default.name: Umbral Form
default.note: Attuned: holds 4 of your M/T while active
default.text: Your body becomes partly shadow. While you are in a Dimmed or Darkened zone, attacks and targeted spells against you lose dice equal to your Shade dots.

spells.name: Eclipse
spells.text: The area goes dark. Not dim. Dark. The kind of dark that drains.

spells.name: Soul Drain
spells.text: Shadow that reaches into a living target and pulls out more than mana.

knowledges.name: Battle Aura
knowledges.focus: Mana through body and weapon. Pairs with Combat Styles.

default.name: Surge
default.text: Push fighting spirit into your body for one Strength, Dexterity, or Fortitude roll that isn’t an attack, such as lifting, climbing, sprinting, or breaking free of a grapple. Each mana adds 1 die, up to the usual cap. Outside of combat, from Rank 2 on, one Surge can carry you through a whole extended task, such as a long climb or a day of hauling.

spells.name: Aura Fist
spells.text: The practitioner's fists or feet are coated in fighting spirit. Lasts for this action only.

spells.name: Aura Blade
spells.text: The wielded weapon is coated in fighting spirit for a single strike.

default.name: Aura Edge
default.note: Attuned: holds 2 of your M/T while active
default.text: Your weapon and unarmed attacks gain Armor Penetration and Magic Penetration equal to half your Battle Aura dots, rounded up. They ignore that many points of the armor portion of a target’s DT, and that many points of the portion added by magic. This stacks with Armor Penetration from your Combat Style.

spells.name: Iron Body
spells.text: The body hardens with concentrated fighting spirit, reinforcing it against incoming strikes.

spells.name: Aura Coat
spells.text: The weapon is coated in a sustained layer of fighting spirit that persists between strikes.

default.name: Aura Read
default.text: Read the fighting spirit of one creature you can see within a number of zones equal to your Battle Aura dots. Roll Perception + Awareness + Battle Aura. On a success you learn its highest Combat Style rank, its Battle Aura rank, and whether it means to fight you right now. With 3 or more successes you also learn whether it is hiding how strong it is.

spells.name: Aegis Pulse
spells.text: A sudden flare of fighting spirit at the moment of impact, hardening the body against the blow.

spells.name: Counter Pulse
spells.text: The practitioner channels their fighting spirit into an immediate counter strike following damage from a melee attack.

default.name: Aura Hand
default.text: Reach out with projected fighting spirit up to 2 zones away and roll Strength + Athletics + Battle Aura. Push or pull a creature 1 zone into an empty zone (Defend: Strength + Athletics), or lift, move, or hold an object you could lift with your own hands, such as opening a door or catching a falling ally.

spells.name: Aura Wave
spells.text: A visible wave of fighting spirit launched forward in a straight line.

spells.name: Aura Parry
spells.text: The practitioner projects their fighting spirit outward at the moment of an incoming attack.

default.name: Battle Presence
default.text: People near you can feel your fighting spirit without being touched. Add your Battle Aura dots to rolls to intimidate, and to your own rolls to resist fear.

spells.name: Aura Cone
spells.text: A fan of fighting spirit projected outward from the body, covering a wide forward arc.

spells.name: Aura Transfer
spells.text: The practitioner channels their fighting spirit directly into an ally, temporarily bolstering their physical capabilities.

default.name: Empowered Flight
default.text: You can fly by projecting fighting spirit downward, following the Flight rules at the start of this section.

spells.name: Twin Wave
spells.text: Two simultaneous waves of fighting spirit projected in different directions.

spells.name: Aura Shroud
spells.text: The practitioner extends their fighting spirit outward to cover allies in a protective layer.

default.name: Sovereign Aura
default.note: Attuned: holds 4 of your M/T while active
default.text: Enemies within a number of zones equal to your Battle Aura dots, whose Battle Aura and Combat Style ratings are all lower than your Battle Aura dots, roll Composure + Presence when they first come into range. If they roll fewer successes than your Battle Aura dots, they lose 1 die on all rolls while they stay in range. Outside of combat, anyone affected won’t start a fight with you unless they’re cornered.

spells.name: Omega Burst
spells.text: A total release of fighting spirit in all directions at once. Every nearby target is pushed back.

spells.name: Aura Ascendant
spells.text: A total channeling of fighting spirit into the body simultaneously enhancing all physical attributes.

knowledges.name: Scroll Magic
knowledges.focus: Spells stored in scrolls to release later.

knowledges.name: Divination
knowledges.focus: Reading information from time, place, and connection.

knowledges.name: Summoning Magic
knowledges.focus: SumMonz, familiars, and calling items through circles.

knowledges.name: Teleportation
knowledges.focus: Instant passage between two prepared circles.

knowledges.name: Binding Rituals
knowledges.focus: Fixing effects, spirits, or entities to objects or places.

knowledges.name: Ward Magic
knowledges.focus: Protective or alerting circles on zones, objects, or thresholds.

knowledges.name: Augmentation
knowledges.focus: Building magic into weapons and gear.

knowledges.name: Spatial Magic
knowledges.focus: Folding space so containers hold far more.

knowledges.name: Time Magic
knowledges.focus: Slowing, speeding, or stopping time in a small area.

stats.name: Willpower
stats.used_for: Social combat health. Spend 1 per turn: +3 dice, or reroll 3 failed dice.
stats.gained: Checks from acting on your drives and holding firm. Full row of checks: +1 dot.

stats.name: Fate
stats.used_for: Weaving the story your way. Fate contests against opposing Fate.
stats.gained: Checks from influence, kept deals, and won contests. Never spent.

stats.name: Sanity
stats.used_for: Resisting the Void. Lost dots bring traumas; at 1 or 10 the Storyteller takes control.
stats.gained: Checks from living life, time with loved ones, and therapy.

stats.name: Mana
stats.used_for: Powers all magic. Pool = (Magic + Circle Magic) x Mana. M/T = Fortitude + Mana.
stats.gained: Freebies (7 per dot) or XP (new dot x7). Pool recovers each Upkeep and quickly between fights.

combos.name: Crushing Vine
combos.text: Living vines fed by flowing water seize the target and squeeze.

combos.name: Cursed Ground
combos.text: Dark energy seeps up through the earth, corrupting the ground itself.

combos.name: Decay
combos.text: Dark organic energy unravels the structure of an incoming spell before it can take effect.

combos.name: Disruption
combos.text: Bright and Shade collide inside a spell as it forms. The result is collapse. The opposing forces tear the cast apart from the inside.

combos.name: Dust Storm
combos.text: Wind-driven stone and grit scour the air, cutting visibility to near zero.

combos.name: Flame Whip
combos.text: A crackling tendril of flaming plant matter snaps across the distance and drags.

combos.name: Hallowed Ground
combos.text: The ground itself glows faintly with radiant force.

combos.name: Magma
combos.text: The earth opens and bleeds molten rock across the zone.

combos.name: Mending Bloom
combos.text: Soft glowing blossoms spread across the zone, breathing light into those who rest within it.

combos.name: Miasma
combos.text: A creeping dark fog that saps the will and precision of anyone breathing it in.

combos.name: Mist
combos.text: Heat meets water and produces a rolling cloud of dense steam.

combos.name: Overgrowth
combos.text: The earth erupts with a wall of thick tangled growth impossible to move through quickly.

combos.name: Plasma
combos.text: Superheated plasma that burns through armor as readily as flesh.

combos.name: Quagmire
combos.text: The earth drinks water until it becomes a sucking trap.

combos.name: Radiant Flame
combos.text: Fire touched by radiant energy. In attack form it burns twice as bright against the dead. In utility form it simply burns, clean and permanent.

combos.name: Radiant Wind
combos.text: Glowing wind that lofts projectiles and steadies aim.

combos.name: Sanctified Water
combos.text: Water infused with radiant energy, purifying to the living and lethal to the dead.

combos.name: Shadowflame
combos.text: Fire that burns dark. In attack form it simply destroys. In condition form it feeds.

combos.name: Spore Cloud
combos.text: A thick organic cloud that gets into everything and makes every movement a struggle.

combos.name: Tempest
combos.text: A concentrated storm that bucks and tosses everything caught inside it.

combos.name: Venom
combos.text: Dark fluid that poisons the living and paradoxically purges conditions from the dead.

combos.name: Ashfall
combos.text: Burning debris falls continuously, choking the zone with heat, ash, and dark energy.

combos.name: Balance
combos.text: Life energy drawn from both light and dark holds a target in perfect, fragile equilibrium.

combos.name: Black Fog
combos.text: Hot poisonous fog that clogs lungs, drains energy, and aids the dead.

combos.name: Choking Ash
combos.text: Grit and dark energy combine into an airborne assault that chokes and drains.

combos.name: Cinders
combos.text: The ground itself smolders with dark fire, burning mana and flesh together.

combos.name: Cleansing Gale
combos.text: A wind that strips away ailments from the living and punishes the dead for breathing.

combos.name: Convergent Flame
combos.text: A fire that burns everything equally, indifferent to what it touches.

combos.name: Cursed Bog
combos.text: A bog of dark water that saps living strength and sustains the dead.

combos.name: Cursed Roots
combos.text: Dark roots that hold on and feed on whatever they catch.

combos.name: Decrease Weight
combos.text: Air carries the target. Bright and Shade open a gap in the way weight applies to them. They are not floating. They are simply much less here than they were.

combos.name: Forge Light
combos.text: A weapon of blazing radiant metal that exists only because it was willed into existence.

combos.name: Glass Shards
combos.text: Sand fused into glass in mid-air and launched as a spray of cutting shards.

combos.name: Hallowed Mire
combos.text: Holy water pressed into the ground, nourishing the living and weakening the dead.

combos.name: Healing Grove
combos.text: A grove of radiant living plants that mends allies and punishes the dead.

combos.name: Hot Sap Spitting Plant
combos.text: A tough organic entity that spits scalding sap on command.

combos.name: Increase Weight
combos.text: Earth locks into the target. Bright and Shade balance the effect into a sustained field. Everything the target does takes more effort than it should.

combos.name: Lava
combos.text: Root channels crack open under the heat of molten earth.

combos.name: Living Rain
combos.text: A rain that carries seeds and spores. By the second turn, the ground is already growing.

combos.name: Miasma Bloom
combos.text: Spores that rot from the inside out, poisoning and draining in the same breath.

combos.name: Phoenix Bloom
combos.text: A creature of living fire and radiant energy that exists to fight or mend.

combos.name: Plague Marsh
combos.text: Stagnant corrupt water choked with diseased growth.

combos.name: Poison Fog
combos.text: Cold poisonous mist. Kills slowly. Feeds the dead.

combos.name: Quagmire Storm
combos.text: A concentrated burst of wet earth launched with enough force to displace and disorient.

combos.name: Radiant Dust
combos.text: Sparkling mineral dust that blinds enemies while guiding allies.

combos.name: Sacred Grove
combos.text: A space where living things are strengthened by the earth and light together.

combos.name: Sacred Steam
combos.text: Radiant steam that burns conditions away from allies and forces undead out.

combos.name: Solar Flare
combos.text: A blast of pure radiant fire that blinds everyone and burns undead twice over.

combos.name: Spore Blast
combos.text: Dandelion-like spores that drift to their destination before detonating.

combos.name: Spore Light
combos.text: Glowing spores that mend allies and disorient everyone else.

combos.name: Swamp
combos.text: A zone made nearly impassable by water and growth working together.

combos.name: Tempest Inferno
combos.text: A superheated storm that scalds, blinds, and scatters.

combos.name: Tidal Convergence
combos.text: A tidal force drawn from opposing energies that moves everything in its path.

combos.name: Vines of Rotfire
combos.text: Burning dark vines that hold on and feed off the living, but free the dead.

combos.name: Volcanic Spring
combos.text: The ground beneath the zone cracks open with scalding eruptions.

combos.name: Wooden Wall
combos.text: Dense timber that did not grow here but exists regardless.

combos.name: Ashen Waste
combos.text: Nothing grows here now, and the dead like it that way.

combos.name: Black Blizzard
combos.text: A winter that eats warmth and mana alike.

combos.name: Black Lightning
combos.text: Lightning that strikes the body and the soul's reserves at once.

combos.name: Blessed Downpour
combos.text: Rain that carries life to everyone it touches.

combos.name: Bog Revenant
combos.text: The bog gives back what it took, and none of it is friendly.

combos.name: Caustic Bloom
combos.text: Lye and rot, flung hard enough to stick.

combos.name: Chain of Heaven
combos.text: It knows exactly who it is looking for.

combos.name: Crucible Bind
combos.text: Heat to soften, weight to hold, and two opposite forces to seal it shut.

combos.name: Crystal Sanctuary
combos.text: A shelter that light passes through and very little else.

combos.name: Drowning Mire
combos.text: It pulls you down, and it does not let go.

combos.name: Ember Rain
combos.text: Rain that feels like a hearth after a long night.

combos.name: Fulgurite Strike
combos.text: Where the lightning ran, the ground turned to glass.

combos.name: Full Gravity
combos.text: Bright and Shade together can regulate fundamental forces when guided by Earth and Air. What they can do to weight in either direction is a matter of how many successes the caster can bring to it.

combos.name: Hearthroot
combos.text: Sit by this fire and the worst of it mends.

combos.name: Kiln Storm
combos.text: Four elements melt, fire, and shatter into a single scouring storm.

combos.name: Kilnborn Guardian
combos.text: Clay fired in the moment, held together by roots that refuse to let go.

combos.name: Mirror Mist
combos.text: You see them. You see them again. You see them everywhere.

combos.name: Monsoon
combos.text: The rains come, and the land answers by growing.

combos.name: Obsidian Storm
combos.text: Black glass that cuts and keeps cutting.

combos.name: Petrify
combos.text: Life held still, neither living nor dead, until it is let go.

combos.name: Plague Fog
combos.text: A sickness with somewhere to be.

combos.name: Pressure of the Deep
combos.text: The whole sea, pressing on one person.

combos.name: Prism Storm
combos.text: Ice that catches the light and turns it into a weapon against the dead.

combos.name: Pyre of Balance
combos.text: What burns away feeds what remains.

combos.name: Sacred Canopy
combos.text: Shade, but the kind made by light.

combos.name: Sap Siphon
combos.text: Taken from one, given to another.

combos.name: Sunforged Armor
combos.text: Armor fired in holy light and cooled in an instant.

combos.name: Sunglass Lens
combos.text: A single point of sunlight, made unbearable.

combos.name: Tar Pit
combos.text: Hot, black, and patient.

combos.name: Teleportation
combos.text: One step here, the next step somewhere else entirely.

combos.name: Thornwood Maze
combos.text: Every way out is a way through thorns.

combos.name: Thunderstorm
combos.text: Rain to carry it, heat to spark it, air to throw it, and something living to call it down.

combos.name: Twilight Steam
combos.text: In the haze between light and dark, spells forget how they were made.

combos.name: Twin Corona
combos.text: Two fires, opposite in every way, agreeing on one thing: keep away.

combos.name: Wellspring
combos.text: The kind of water people walk for days to find.

combos.name: Renewal
combos.text: What was lost grows back as though it had never been gone.

combos.name: Black Meteor
combos.text: The sky goes dark before it lands.

combos.name: Blackfire Wildwood
combos.text: A forest that burns and keeps growing anyway.

combos.name: Drowned World
combos.text: The water rises, and it brings the bottom of the lake with it.

combos.name: Gravity Tide
combos.text: Gravity, rearranged like furniture.

combos.name: Gravity Well
combos.text: Everything falls toward the fire.

combos.name: Lifeforge
combos.text: The forge where bodies are made whole again.

combos.name: Phoenix Form
combos.text: Wings of fire that burn your enemies and warm your friends.

combos.name: Plague Storm
combos.text: A storm that does not pass. It lingers and it spreads.

combos.name: Primordial Storm
combos.text: Fire, flood, wind, stone, and root, all arriving together.

combos.name: Reshape the Land
combos.text: The map is now a suggestion.

combos.name: Rotting Caldera
combos.text: Fire, rot, and steam rising from a wound in the world.

combos.name: Sky Citadel
combos.text: A hill that decided it would rather be a cloud.

combos.name: Soul Lightning
combos.text: It takes what they had and hands it to someone better.

combos.name: Starforged Titan
combos.text: A guardian built from everything the forge can give.

combos.name: Stormbreaker
combos.text: Where it passes, the magic of others simply comes undone.

combos.name: Sunfall
combos.text: A piece of the sun, dropped with intent.

combos.name: Veil Rain
combos.text: Some are hidden in it. Some cannot hide from it.

combos.name: Verdant Sanctuary
combos.text: A place the dead cannot reach and the living do not want to leave.

combos.name: Worldroot
combos.text: The ground itself takes a side.

combos.name: Wrath of the Sun
combos.text: A line drawn across the world in light.

combos.name: Grand Restoration
combos.text: As though none of it had ever happened.

combos.name: Heartfire Bond
combos.text: Many fires, one flame.

combos.name: Resurrection
combos.text: Light and shadow together pull a soul back across the threshold.

combos.name: Nightfall
combos.text: The sun goes out, and it is not coming back for a while.

combos.name: Starfall
combos.text: The sky falls, one star at a time, all at once.

combos.name: Sunrise
combos.text: The night ends early, and everyone can feel it.

combos.name: Titan Awakening
combos.text: The mountain stood up.

combos.name: Creation Magic
combos.text: The single combination of all seven schools: the only magic that brings new life into the world.

spells.name: Tailwind
spells.text: While attuned and flying, move one extra zone each turn at no AP cost.

spells.name: Rooftop Call
spells.text: A call heard across a settlement. Birds and avian kin who hear it answer one simple question per success about what they have seen.

spells.name: Dive Strike
spells.text: Attack after descending at least one zone this turn. Add your Heritage dots to the damage roll.

spells.name: Feather Flurry
spells.text: The target resists with Perception + Awareness. If you beat them, they suffer -2 dice on sight-based rolls on their next turn.

spells.name: Updraft
spells.text: Move the ally one zone at no AP cost to them.

spells.name: Screech
spells.text: Every enemy in range resists with Composure + Presence. Each one you beat loses their next Reaction.

spells.name: Wind Rider
